name: GCP — Cloud Storage Bucket Made Publicly Accessible
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation_sub_type = "storage.setIamPolicy" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "storage.buckets"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "allUsers" or xdm.event.description contains "allAuthenticatedUsers"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as exposures,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: storage.setIamPolicy or storage.buckets method granting allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers — bucket exposed to the internet.
alert_name: GCP — Cloud Storage Bucket Made Publicly Accessible
alert_description:
What fired: storage.setIamPolicy or storage.buckets method granting allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers — bucket exposed to the internet.

Why it matters: data is being gathered or exposed for later theft. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object (TA0009 - Collection).

Investigate:
  - Identify the resource made accessible/collected and the responsible principal.
  - Check the exposure scope (public vs internal) and whether a download/exfil followed.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0009 - Collection: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
